snippet.title: Garden and a Goat - Alpha 2 Highlights!
snippet.description:
We finished up our Alpha 2 playtest a few weeks ago. Here's some clips of what our players saw and did. Wishlist now to stay connected and we'll keep you updated on the open beta coming at the start of 2026 with early access in summer!

Wishlist on Steam at: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3156550/Garden_and_a_Goat/

Join our Discord to chat with the team and players following the game: https://gardenandagoat.com/discord

#gaming #indiegames #gardengames #videogames #games #cozygaming
